name: Kolbingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kolbingen (three white leaves and a wavy bar on red).
history: Municipal flag of Kolbingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Kolbingen arms — leaves and wavy bar on red
